result.topic_en: A pencil note on the validity of the integral representation of Riemann's P-function under the assumption that the exponents α, β, γ, δ are real and greater than −1, with an attempt to extend it to imaginary values by splitting the integral near the endpoints 0 and 1 using factors 1/(e^{2απi}−1).

methods.what: Analytic continuation of a Euler-type integral in the exponents: replacing the endpoint piece by an integral around a small circle about the endpoint, divided by e^{2απi}−1
Decomposition of the integral from 0 to 1 into a middle part and loop contributions around the endpoints 0 and 1, valid for all exponents
